statement: SELECT avg(abs(s.f3 - (exp(t.f3)-1))) AS mad_expm1, max(abs(s.f3 - (exp(t.f3)-1))) AS maxd_expm1, avg(abs(t.f3 - ln(s.f3+1))) AS mad_log1p, corr(t.f3, ln(s.f3+1)) AS corr_log1p FROM workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.training_sample t JOIN workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.serving_log s ON t.entity_id=s.entity_id
